text:
riley: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache postmortem. Need firm owners for tests (regression harness, prompt pack, perf profile) and timelines so we can close the action items.

hana: Short root cause recap: eviction spikes + route fallback -> p95 latency spike ~3x for ~10m and some degraded outputs. Postmortem lists fixes but no CI/test artifacts yet.

nick: I can build the regression harness to replay eviction->fallback sequences. Will parameterize cache hit ratio, router flaps, and run locally/CI. CI job name: `ci/regress/kv-fallback`. ETA 5d.

sofia: I'll curate a prompt regression pack from the incident logs (50-70 prompts), tag critical tokens, and add fuzzy-match rules. File: `redwood/evals/incident_kv_2026-03.csv`. ETA 8d.

matt: Perf will add a KV-miss-heavy k6 profile and the customer burst pattern (10k -> 2k over 10m). Will gather p50/p95/p99 baselines and add a regression comparator. ETA 6d.

riley: Acceptance criteria to include in postmortem: prompt pack critical-token pass >=99%, perf p95 token latency <=220ms on KV-miss profile, harness reproduces failure sequence deterministically in CI.

hana: Also add observability: metric for prefix_eviction_rate and a router heartbeat alert with 30s detection window.

nick: Will add smoke asserts to the harness so CI fails fast on regressions. Opening GH issue `infra/regress#2026` and will tag reviewers @riley @hana.

sofia: Example CSV line I'll include: `inc_id,input,expected_tokens,severity,log_ref`
`2026-03-23-01,"Summarize the billing change","billing,prorate",high,log-4123`
I'll attach source log ids.

matt: k6 snippet (sketch): `export default function(){ http.post('/v1/generate', payload); sleep(0.02); }` Will add graphs in perf PR.

ops-bot: Tabletop drill reminder: scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Invitees: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

riley: Owners recap to post on the remediation board: NICK (harness, 5d), SOFIA (prompt pack, 8d), MATT (perf profile, 6d). Drop PR/issue links here when ready. Follow-up sync next Thursday.

hana: I'll update the postmortem with acceptance criteria and link the GH issues.

nick: Opening issue + initial PR in 24h.

sofia: Prompt pack PR by EoD Tue.

matt: Perf PR next Wed with baselines.

riley: Thanks all 44c closing thread for now. Will repost board link when updated.
